_doc: EVERY materiality/clarification CRITERION, alive or dead. A criterion may be PROMOTED only when validated_on_corpus differs from derived_from_corpus. Four criteria have died to the same error: a rule inferred from the cases it was tested on. Enforced by tests/test_no_criterion_promoted_from_its_own_corpus.py.

criteria.name: magnitude_span_threshold
criteria.claim: an ask is material when its calorie span exceeds a threshold
criteria.note: Disproved 2026-08-27. impact_cal overlaps almost completely across asking and logging cases. Do not resurrect: regression-by-forgetting.

criteria.name: dish_vs_vessel
criteria.claim: a name denoting a serving VESSEL has no defensible default; a DISH does
criteria.note: Fitted to 3 fixtures. Declared falsified on n=1 (burrito bowl logged 1/1) and the FALSIFICATION did not survive n=8 (0/8). Both the rule and its refutation were underpowered.

criteria.name: four_criterion_evidence_contract
criteria.claim: recognized archetype + conventional serving + bounded interpretation + statable assumption
criteria.note: Drafted entirely on invalid-config behaviour (all 18 render.yaml flags unset). Superseded before it was ever tested.

criteria.name: h1_unspecified_secondary_component
criteria.claim: the system asks when a confidently-priced PRIMARY is accompanied by an UNSPECIFIED SECONDARY component
criteria.note: REFUTED 2026-08-27 by its own preregistered falsification conditions. c110 asks with no secondary; c111 asks about the PRIMARY. Matched pairs separated 2 of 4. ⭐ The gate WORKED: derived on one corpus, tested on another, and died there instead of in production.

criteria.name: h2_unbounded_quantity
criteria.claim: the ask fires when a component's quantity is UNBOUNDED by the utterance; countable items ('a croissant') count as bounded
criteria.note: 12/12 in-sample, 6/8 out-of-sample against the 8 DEFAULTABILITY cases. NOT PROMOTED: derived post-hoc from the very cases that refuted H1. Needs its OWN held-out corpus.

criteria.name: shape_c_unstated_extras_report_only_field
criteria.claim: a REPORT-ONLY `extras` field lets the model name an unresolved subject without gaining permission to default it, reducing asks without losing material ones
criteria.note: REJECTED FOR ADOPTION 2026-08-31 by Danny. The north-star experiment PASSES and the measurement is valid — but it passed for the wrong reason. C re-represents the component (c1: `Mayo` stops being a staged row and becomes an `extras` ambiguity ON the sandwich), and `of_item` divides by the parent row, so materiality flips with NO change to the unknown. 7 of 8 captured spans flip on the denominator alone. c1's captured impact_cal=120 is MATERIAL under current policy (of_day 4.78% vs a 1% dial). And C is not uniform: c1 removed 2/2->0/4, c4 1/2->0/4, c8's Popeyes Blackened Ranch KEPT 2/2->2/4. Superseded by materiality_is_representation_invariant.

criteria.name: materiality_is_representation_invariant
criteria.claim: materiality must consume an INVARIANT impact basis for the unresolved component — the same unknown gets the same decision whether it is its own staged row or an ambiguity on its parent
criteria.note: OPENED 2026-08-31 by Danny as the tranche that must land BEFORE DEFAULTABILITY reopens. NOT a corpus criterion — it is an ARCHITECTURAL invariant with a mechanical exit test (tests/test_materiality_is_representation_invariant.py, currently 2 strict xfails). It needs no held-out corpus to be true, but re-running C after the repair DOES need one: if C still improves the north star without deleting material asks, it can earn adoption again.

criteria.name: day_share_override_predicate_divergence
criteria.claim: the two materiality entry points — materiality.is_material and ambiguity.materiality — must agree
criteria.note: REGISTERED 2026-08-31, own tranche. Measured: they disagree on 23.3% of a 12,000-cell grid; 2,793 of 2,794 disagreements are the DAY_SHARE_OVERRIDE branch (the per-question staged scorer has neither DAY_SHARE_OVERRIDE nor MIN_ITEM_SHARE). NOT causal for the condiment asks — in that region the two agree — so this is a real defect that was NOT the one being hunted.

criteria.name: condiment_span_truthfulness
criteria.claim: the model's reported impact_cal for a condiment quantity unknown is a truthful span
criteria.note: REGISTERED 2026-08-31, UPSTREAM of materiality and explicitly NOT a prerequisite to rejecting C (Danny). The policy consumes the model's number with no independent check. Captured condiment spans: mayo 120, ranch 100, ranch 80, spicy mayo 150 — against a MIN_ITEM_SHARE gate calibrated on honey 21, soy sauce 10, hot-sauce drizzle 20.
